title: Small Brownian Loops Hitting SLE$_2$: An Exact Natural-Content Limit
summary: Let $D$ be a bounded analytic Jordan domain and let $γ$ be chordal $\mathrm{SLE}_2$ in $D$, equipped with its $5/4$-dimensional natural-content measure $μ_γ$. We retain the root in the standard integrated Brownian-bridge representation of Brownian loop measure and let $\mathcal M_\varepsilon^γ$ be the root-intensity measure of loops with duration in $[\varepsilon^2,t_0]$ whose traces hit $γ$. For every $f\in C_c(D)$, we prove that $\varepsilon^{5/4}\mathcal M_\varepsilon^γ(f)$ converges in $L^1$ to $\frac{4}{5π}\bar v_{\mathrm{BB}}μ_γ(f)$, where $\bar v_{\mathrm{BB}}\in(0,\infty)$ is the…
